subject: Marketplace technical onboarding and co-sell readiness - ByteBridge
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bytebridge.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-15T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Technical onboarding for marketplace listing + co-sell readiness

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday — impressed with Redwood's latency footprint and the routing features. We are ready to move forward with a Marketplace listing and would like to align on the technical evidence and co-sell mechanics so we can meet our internal launch window (early December).

High level asks:
- What exact technical artifacts do you need for listing approval on GCP and AWS?
- Any preferred format for demo images / sample workloads?
- Can Redwood provide a short reference SKU and trial credits for our sales demos?

I attached our architecture diagram and a draft SOW for context. Happy to hop on a call this week.

Cheers,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, ByteBridge Analytics
Attachments: bytebridge-arch-diagram.pdf, partner-sow-draft.docx

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bytebridge.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-16T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding for marketplace listing + co-sell readiness

Hi Sanjay — great to connect. Looping in Olga (partner integrations) and Ben (co-sell ops) to drive the evidence checklist and GTM requirements.

Quick answers up front:
- Technical artifacts: architecture diagram (you sent), a short tech-evidence list (runbook, basic perf numbers, auth/integration points), and a minimal demo image with steps to reproduce. For AWS/GCP we separately need metering guidance for SKUs and a short network diagram for private offers.
- Demo format: a 5-7 minute runnable demo with a sample dataset is ideal; a lightweight terraform or deployment script helps our validation team.
- Trial credits: Ben — can you confirm typical trial SKU / credit amounts we can offer for partner demos?

Olga — can you draft the specific evidence checklist for ByteBridge (GCP + AWS)? I propose a 2-week evidence sprint starting next Monday (10/23) so we hit a Nov certification review.

Sanjay — I put the Drive folder in related_links and will follow up with a calendar invite after we finalize the sprint scope.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bytebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding for marketplace listing + co-sell readiness

Hi team — thanks for the context and attachments, Sanjay. I reviewed the architecture diagram; looks good but we need a couple of clarifications for the listing gate:

Required from ByteBridge (technical evidence checklist):
- Minimal reproducible deployment (terraform + simple dataset) for GCP and AWS (we validate both).
- Application-level telemetry sample (span/trace or token-level cost breakdown) to verify billing signals.
- IAM and network diagram showing where the model artifacts are hosted and any VPC peering or PrivateLink.
- Security questionnaire answers for data residency and access controls (SOC2 pointer if available).
- Sample policy for tenant isolation (if multi-tenant).

Optional but helpful:
- A short perf snapshot (p95 latency with 256 tokens and request volume baseline).
- Suggested SKU mapping (trial SKU, prod SKU, and metering unit) — Ben, can Redwood propose defaults if ByteBridge prefers that?

If ByteBridge can get the reproducible deployment and the telemetry sample into the Drive folder by 10/24 EOD, we can run a validation pass the week of 10/25. I will own the evidence tracker and gate the technical sign-off.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Partner Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bytebridge.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-19T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding for marketplace listing + co-sell readiness

Sanjay — happy to handle the SKU/trial side. Proposal:
- Trial SKU: "bytebridge-trial-100" mapped to a 30-day free credit of $1,000 (or equivalent usage cap).
- Prod SKU: "bytebridge-prod" billed per-token with host/region tags.
- Co-sell readiness checklist: customer-facing demo script, 1-pager value props, two joint sales plays (data-platform and modern infra).

I'll create the HubSpot deal (linked above) and add the GTM checklist. For private offers we will need a contact in your procurement/legal to route terms and any marketplace private offer paperwork. Vivek — can you advise on any billing-side questions for outbound mapping and private offer SLA tokens?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@bytebridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-22T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding for marketplace listing + co-sell readiness

Quick billing and procurement notes:
- For AWS Private Offer: we require the marketplace SKU manifest plus the contract stub (DocuSign link acceptable). Elena/ByteBridge legal should confirm billing entity for tax and POC routing.
- For GCP: ensure the SKU naming convention includes region tags and metering unit (tokens/min or tokens/1000). We can accept Redwood-managed metering tags to backfill usage if ByteBridge cannot emit them immediately.
- I will assign a billing engineer to the HubSpot deal once Ben creates it; please include expected ARR range and preferred billing cadence.

Sanjay — can you share the procurement contact and confirm whether ByteBridge requires Redwood to be the seller of record for initial pilot? That will affect the private offer path.

Thanks all — pushing to keep the evidence sprint timeline (10/23 start) but we can shift one week if ByteBridge needs more time.

-Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Commercial Partnerships, Redwood Inference
